name: OpenV Platform Requirements
description: Comprehensive requirements, hazards, design items, and test protocol for OpenV as a competitive open-source alternative to IBM DOORS.

artifacts.title: OpenV Requirements Management Platform
artifacts.body: Long-term requirements for OpenV to match and exceed IBM DOORS capabilities while remaining open-source and local-first.

artifacts.title: Authentication
artifacts.body: The system shall support OIDC and local authentication with configurable policies.

artifacts.title: Role-based access control
artifacts.body: The system shall enforce RBAC for project and artifact operations.

artifacts.title: Audit logging
artifacts.body: The system shall log create, update, delete, link, and export operations.

artifacts.title: Encryption
artifacts.body: The system shall encrypt data in transit and at rest.

artifacts.title: Backup and restore
artifacts.body: The system shall provide automated backups and restore workflows.

artifacts.title: PDF reports
artifacts.body: The system shall generate PDF reports with traceability sections and attachments.

artifacts.title: JSON export
artifacts.body: The system shall export full project data to JSON.

artifacts.title: Trace reports
artifacts.body: The system shall generate trace matrix reports for selected artifact types.

artifacts.title: Accessibility
artifacts.body: The system shall meet WCAG 2.1 AA guidelines for all core workflows.

artifacts.title: Keyboard efficiency
artifacts.body: The system shall support keyboard shortcuts for common actions.

artifacts.title: Data loss
artifacts.body: Loss of artifact data due to corruption or operator error.

artifacts.title: Unauthorized access
artifacts.body: Access to artifacts by unauthorized users.

artifacts.title: Traceability breakage
artifacts.body: Links become invalid or inconsistent over time.

artifacts.body: Human factors and accessibility requirements.

artifacts.body: Scalability, stability, and operational targets.

artifacts.title: Reporting and Export
artifacts.body: Exports, reports, and trace matrices.

artifacts.body: Verification and validation plan.

artifacts.title: Risks and Hazards
artifacts.body: Hazards and mitigations for safety and data integrity.

artifacts.title: API consistency
artifacts.body: The system shall provide versioned REST APIs for all core operations.

artifacts.title: Repository pattern
artifacts.body: The system shall isolate persistence concerns via repository interfaces.

artifacts.title: RBAC enforcement
artifacts.body: Policy engine for role-based permissions.

artifacts.title: Schema migrations
artifacts.body: The system shall support schema migrations without data loss.

artifacts.title: Audit log service
artifacts.body: Append-only audit log with export.

artifacts.title: Authentication service
artifacts.body: OIDC and local auth provider integration.

artifacts.title: Backup scheduler
artifacts.body: Automated backup and restore workflows.

artifacts.title: Baseline engine
artifacts.body: Snapshot artifacts and links for immutable baselines.

artifacts.title: Link validation rules
artifacts.body: Rule engine for link type validation.

artifacts.title: Export pipeline
artifacts.body: Project export and report generation service.

artifacts.title: Search indexer
artifacts.body: Search index support for large projects.

artifacts.title: Scope
artifacts.body: OpenV shall support requirements authoring, versioning, baselines, and traceability across engineering disciplines.

artifacts.title: Stakeholders
artifacts.body: Primary users include systems engineers, verification engineers, and compliance leads in regulated industries.

artifacts.title: Guiding Principles
artifacts.body: Local-first, open-source, API-driven, and automation-friendly.

artifacts.title: Artifact management
artifacts.body: The system shall create, edit, version, and archive artifacts with full history and audit metadata.

artifacts.title: Module view
artifacts.body: The system shall provide a hierarchical module view with drag-and-drop ordering and filters.

artifacts.title: Rich text and attachments
artifacts.body: The system shall support rich text descriptions and file attachments for artifacts.

artifacts.title: Baselines
artifacts.body: The system shall create immutable baselines that snapshot artifacts and links.

artifacts.title: Search and filters
artifacts.body: The system shall provide full-text search and multi-criteria filters across projects.

artifacts.title: Bulk operations
artifacts.body: The system shall support bulk edits, imports, and deletion workflows with confirmations.

artifacts.title: Review workflow
artifacts.body: The system shall support review cycles with approvals, rejections, and comments.

artifacts.title: Notifications
artifacts.body: The system shall notify users of changes and review actions.

artifacts.title: Link type validation
artifacts.body: The system shall enforce link type rules, including inverse labels and allowed artifact types.

artifacts.title: Coverage analysis
artifacts.body: The system shall calculate coverage of requirements by test cases and design items.

artifacts.title: Impact analysis
artifacts.body: The system shall compute upstream and downstream impacts for any artifact.

artifacts.title: Trace matrix
artifacts.body: The system shall generate trace matrices for selected artifact types.

artifacts.title: Webhooks
artifacts.body: The system shall emit webhooks for artifact and link changes.

artifacts.title: Plugin framework
artifacts.body: The system shall provide a plugin framework for custom rules and integrations.

artifacts.title: Import and export
artifacts.body: The system shall import and export data in JSON and CSV, with ReqIF planned.

artifacts.title: Interactive performance
artifacts.body: The system shall respond to standard UI actions in under 250 ms for projects up to 10,000 artifacts.

artifacts.title: Reliability
artifacts.body: The system shall provide 99.5% uptime in supported deployments.

artifacts.title: Artifact CRUD test
artifacts.body: Create, update, version, and delete artifacts and verify history.

artifacts.title: Link validation test
artifacts.body: Attempt invalid links and verify validation errors.

artifacts.title: Baseline snapshot test
artifacts.body: Create baseline and ensure artifacts and links are frozen.

artifacts.title: Export and report test
artifacts.body: Export JSON and generate PDF with traceability sections.

artifacts.title: RBAC enforcement test
artifacts.body: Verify permission enforcement across roles.

artifacts.title: Performance test
artifacts.body: Load 10,000 artifacts and verify UI response time.
